competitorWins: Sentinel Hub is the genuine professional platform: a cloud REST API that processes petabytes of satellite imagery server-side without downloads, with configurable band math, multi-temporal analysis, statistical APIs, cloud-optimized access and on-demand processing across Sentinel, Landsat and commercial PlanetScope data. For developers and remote-sensing professionals who need programmatic, scalable Earth-observation pipelines, it is the industrial tool — used at scale by firms like Anduril and Aerospace Corp. No consumer globe competes with that.
description: Sentinel Hub (built by Sinergise, now part of Planet) is a cloud platform for processing and analyzing satellite imagery at scale — a REST API where processing units are metered by pixels, bands and requests, with the EO Browser as its free viewer. It is built for developers and researchers, not casual viewers. WorldEye is complementary for the audience: high-res satellite imagery (Pro) on a free, signup-free 3D globe, combined with live flights, ships, cameras, weather, quakes and wildfires — a visual intelligence view, not an API pipeline.
